name: russian-speech
description: Literate Russian technical prose for the agent: a normative style skill plus an always-on SessionStart directive. Grammatical engineer-to-engineer Russian, meaning-first translation of engineering terms, no literal calques (lane, identity, reconcile, gate, trigger), exact resource names preserved. Ships compact style rules, a short terminology table, and reporting templates in one skill file.

interface.longDescription: Makes the agent write grammatical, engineer-to-engineer Russian technical prose: meaning-first translation of engineering terms, no literal calques, exact product/API/resource names preserved, no anthropomorphized components, no color metaphors for CI/CD state. Ships compact style rules, a short terminology table, and reporting templates in one skill file.
defaultPrompt: Use $russian-speech:russian-speech to write grammatical Russian technical prose following the compact style rules.
